title: Possible GitHub fine-grained token in source
description: A string with the shape of a GitHub fine-grained personal access token (github_pat_ followed by token characters) was found in source. Anyone with repository access can use a live token with its scopes until it is revoked.
remediation: Revoke the token immediately in GitHub settings, audit what it accessed, and replace it with a fine-grained token with minimal scopes stored outside version control. This detection does not prove the token is live.
limitation: Shape-only: matches the github_pat_ prefix format, which cannot prove a live credential. Short fragments and documentation mentions do not match.
